response.original_title: St. Francis: Legacy of an Artist
response.overview: The film explores the life and enduring legacy of St. Francis of Assisi and his profound influence on Western art and culture. Following the seeds he planted in the Church and the artistic movements they helped inspire, the film traces a legacy that reaches from the Medieval world into the Renaissance and beyond.
